style: Painterly realistic character concept for a 2D adventure game set in the Russian North around 1910, soft hand-painted digital painting, natural light, neutral standing A-pose with arms slightly away from the body, full figure visible from head to shoes, the same character from front, side and back, plain empty background, no text

items.pavel: Pavel, a 48-year-old village miller: broad-shouldered and strong, slightly stooped from carrying sacks; square weathered face, short beard going grey, tired kind eyes; flour dust on sleeves and trousers; a long coarse sackcloth apron over a faded blue-grey linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a dark wool waistcoat, a worn peaked cloth cap, dark trousers tucked into heavy leather boots; he has lived alone for a year and looks a little neglected; palette of flour-white, grey-blue and brown
items.mitya: Mitya, a 37-year-old river ferryman: tall, lean and sinewy; long weathered face with a full dark beard greying at the temples, deep-set calm eyes, rosy wind-burnt cheeks and the same round broad features as his mother, a sturdy village ferrywoman; a sheepskin coat (tulup) belted with a rope, a fur hat with ear flaps, thick wool mittens tucked into the belt, felt boots (valenki); winter palette of sheepskin cream, brown and charcoal
items.nina: Nina, a 67-year-old village schoolteacher: slim, very straight back, dignified; oval face with fine wrinkles, dark brown intelligent eyes and a straight nose, fully grey hair in a low bun; small round reading glasses hanging on a cord around the neck; a long plain dark charcoal wool dress with a high collar, a warm grey knitted shawl around the shoulders, black lace-up boots; calm, tired and kind; palette of charcoal, grey and soft cream
items.ilya: Ilya, a 32-year-old village carpenter: tall and broad, strong forearms; open friendly face with a short brown beard, dark brown eyes, a pencil tucked behind his right ear; wood shavings stuck to his clothes; a collarless homespun linen shirt (kosovorotka) with rolled sleeves, a leather work apron, dark wool trousers tucked into boots; palette of linen, leather brown and dark green
items.ulyana: Ulyana, an 8-year-old village girl: small and lively, round face, dark brown eyes, two thin braids with ribbons; a too-big wool coat thrown over a long white nightshirt, felt boots; curious bright expression; child proportions; palette of rust-red coat, white and grey
items.ilya_wife: The wife of a village carpenter, about 30 years old: calm and practical, average height; gentle round face, light brown hair under a patterned headscarf (platok); a long dark green skirt, a warm quilted jacket, a knitted shawl; holding a lit kerosene lamp in one hand; palette of dark green, ochre and cream
items.manager: An old mill manager, about 70 years old: thin, slightly bent, walking with a cane; long face with grey side-whiskers and a moustache, sharp but tired eyes; a worn dark-blue formal frock coat with brass buttons, an old peaked uniform cap, dark trousers, polished but cracked boots; palette of faded navy, brass and grey
